title: Austin's Sparse 1883 City Meeting
summary:
• **Quorum Issues**: The council meeting on April 5, 1883 was severely understaffed, with only 3 of 11 aldermen present and 8 absent, raising questions about governance capacity in early Austin.

• **Immediate Adjournment**: Rather than conduct business, the council voted to adjourn the meeting almost immediately, suggesting either lack of urgent matters or inability to proceed without more members present.

• **Leadership Present**: Mayor W.A. Saylor presided over the brief session, with City Clerk J.S. Purnell recording the minimal proceedings.
